answer: Each identity must pick one narrow specialty on the reef and sink non-transferable capital into it — tools, data, and relationships useless elsewhere. A falcon audit tests deep expertise no generalist can fake across many masks at once. Hollow identities with no specialty earn nothing, and each extra clone in the same specialty saturates its market, so marginal returns fall while sunk costs multiply; running fifty clones means fifty separate specialties, each paid in full, with no pooling.
